name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]


permissions: {}

jobs:
  test-macos:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: Swift ${{ matrix.swift }} on macOS ${{ matrix.macos }} with Xcode ${{ matrix.xcode }}${{ matrix.traits != '' && format(' and --traits {0}', matrix.traits) || '' }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    env:
      DEVELOPER_DIR: "/Applications/Xcode_${{ matrix.xcode }}.app/Contents/Developer"
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - macos: "26"
            runner: macos-26
            swift: "6.3.1"
            xcode: "26.4.1"
            traits: ""
          - macos: "26"
            runner: macos-26
            swift: "6.3.1"
            xcode: "26.4.1"
            traits: "AsyncHTTPClient"
          - macos: "26"
            runner: macos-26
            swift: "6.3"
            xcode: "26.6"
            traits: ""
          - macos: "26"
            runner: macos-26
            swift: "6.3"
            xcode: "26.6"
            traits: "AsyncHTTPClient"
          - macos: "27"
            runner: xcode-27
            swift: "6.4"
            xcode: "27.0"
            traits: ""
          - macos: "27"
            runner: xcode-27
            swift: "6.4"
            xcode: "27.0"
            traits: "AsyncHTTPClient"
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # Swift 6.4's default build system compiles MLX's Metal shaders,
      # and the Xcode 27 runner image doesn't include the Metal toolchain.
      - name: Identify Xcode build
        if: matrix.swift == '6.4'
        id: xcode
        run: echo "build=$(xcodebuild -version | awk '/Build version/ { print $3 }')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Cache Metal toolchain download
        if: matrix.swift == '6.4'
        id: metal-cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/metal-toolchain
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-metal-${{ steps.xcode.outputs.build }}

      - name: Download Metal toolchain
        if: matrix.swift == '6.4' && steps.metal-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain -exportPath "$HOME/.cache/metal-toolchain"

      - name: Install Metal toolchain
        if: matrix.swift == '6.4'
        run: |
          xcrun --kill-cache
          if ! xcrun metal --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            for bundle in "$HOME/.cache/metal-toolchain/"*.exportedBundle; do
              xcodebuild -importComponent MetalToolchain -importPath "$bundle"
            done
            xcrun --kill-cache
          fi
          xcrun metal --version

      - name: Cache Swift Package Manager dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/org.swift.swiftpm
            .build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-swift-${{ matrix.swift }}-${{ matrix.traits == '' && 'ahc-off' || 'ahc-on' }}-spm-${{ hashFiles('Package.swift', 'Package.resolved') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-swift-${{ matrix.swift }}-${{ matrix.traits == '' && 'ahc-off' || 'ahc-on' }}-spm-

      - name: Lint
        run: swift format lint --strict --recursive .

      - name: Remove cached build descriptions
        # Descriptions contain Metal compiler paths
        # from the previous runner's temporary mount.
        # Keep compiled outputs for incremental builds.
        if: matrix.swift == '6.4'
        run: rm -rf .build/out/Intermediates.noindex/XCBuildData/*.xcbuilddata

      - name: Build
        run: swift build --build-tests --traits MLX,Llama,CoreML${{ matrix.traits != '' && format(',{0}', matrix.traits) || '' }}

      - name: Test
        run: swift test --skip-build --traits MLX,Llama,CoreML${{ matrix.traits != '' && format(',{0}', matrix.traits) || '' }}

  build-watchos:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: Build for watchOS with Xcode 27
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Build for watchOS
        run: xcodebuild build -scheme AnyLanguageModel -destination 'generic/platform=watchOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

      - name: Build tests for watchOS Simulator
        run: xcodebuild build-for-testing -scheme AnyLanguageModel -destination 'generic/platform=watchOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

  test-linux:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: Swift ${{ matrix.swift }} on Linux${{ matrix.traits != '' && format(' and --traits {0}', matrix.traits) || '' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: swift:${{ matrix.swift }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - swift: "6.3.3"
            traits: ""
          - swift: "6.3.3"
            traits: "AsyncHTTPClient"
          - swift: "6.4.0"
            traits: ""
          - swift: "6.4.0"
            traits: "AsyncHTTPClient"
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Cache Swift Package Manager dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/org.swift.swiftpm
            .build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-swift-${{ matrix.swift }}-${{ matrix.traits == '' && 'ahc-off' || 'ahc-on' }}-spm-${{ hashFiles('Package.swift', 'Package.resolved') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-swift-${{ matrix.swift }}-${{ matrix.traits == '' && 'ahc-off' || 'ahc-on' }}-spm-

      - name: Lint
        run: swift format lint --strict --recursive .

      - name: Build
        run: swift build${{ matrix.traits != '' && format(' --traits {0}', matrix.traits) || '' }}

      - name: Test
        run: swift test${{ matrix.traits != '' && format(' --traits {0}', matrix.traits) || '' }}
